title: A Voxel-Spacing-Aware Extension of PyRadiomics for Anisotropic Texture Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.14103v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Radiomic texture features are commonly extracted from anisotropic CT and MRI acquisitions, where identical voxel offsets may represent different physical distances. We implemented and validated a voxel-spacing-aware extension of PyRadiomics that incorporates spacing information without generating interpolated gray levels. The framework operates across the Python frontend, C wrapper, and computational backend. GLCM uses anisotropy-relative feature-level angular aggregation, NGTDM uses anisotropy-relative weighted neighborhood averaging, and GLRLM, GLDM, and GLSZM are computed on a finite-volume zero-order-hold representation derived from the native anisotropic grid. Synthetic 3D phantoms were used for software validation. The modified implementation reproduced standard PyRadiomics exactly when spacing-aware mode was disabled and remained equivalent under isotropic spacing across 75 texture features. translated_title: 一种感知体素间距的PyRadiomics扩展用于各向异性纹理分析
translated_abstract: 放射组学纹理特征通常从各向异性的CT和MRI采集中提取，其中相同的体素偏移可能代表不同的物理距离。我们实现并验证了一个感知体素间距的PyRadiomics扩展，该扩展在不生成插值灰度的情况下纳入间距信息。该框架覆盖Python前端、C包装器和计算后端。GLCM使用各向异性相对的特征级角度聚合，NGTDM使用各向异性相对的加权邻域平均，而GLRLM、GLDM和GLSZM则在由原生各向异性网格导出的有限体积零阶保持表示上计算。合成3D体模被用于软件验证。修改后的实现在禁用间距感知模式时与标准PyRadiomics完全一致，并在各向同性间距下于75个纹理特征上保持等效。在各向异性间距下，该方法...
tldr: 该论文实现并验证了PyRadiomics的感知体素间距扩展，能够在不生成插值灰度的情况下准确处理各向异性CT和MRI数据的纹理特征提取，同时保证在各向同性条件下与标准实现完全等效。
en_tdlr: This paper implements and validates a voxel-spacing-aware extension of PyRadiomics that accurately handles anisotropic CT and MRI texture feature extraction without generating interpolated gray levels, while remaining exactly equivalent to the standard implementation under isotropic conditions.
